page.overview:
Who is Calyban?

Calyban is a who can first be found eating on top of the walls of . If speaks to her, she will tell him that she cannot eat with Link staring judgmentally at her and tells him to go away.

Calyban plays a role in the , "", which begins with the child, , crying because a water trough is unusable due to a flow of in it. will find rinds flowing down into the trough through the upper waterway and must follow where they are coming from to find the source of the pollution. This leads Link to Calyban, who is throwing the rinds into the waterway.

When talks to , she rudely insists that she can do what she wants. Stating that altruism is for suckers, refuses to stop eating melons unless brings her ten . are often found in cold places, such as the and .

Once has collected ten and returns to give them to , she is amazed at how delicious they are. says that she may stop eating other fruit entirely if she has . She then realizes how selfish she has been and leaves to go help clean up the melon rinds.
